observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage set with plants and a sofa in the background
observation.formation_and_space: solo dancer moving freely across the stage
observation.posture: upright torso with soft, slightly bent knees and shifting weight
observation.footwork: fast tapping and stepping, heel-toe weight shifts, kicking and swiveling feet on beats
observation.arms_and_hands: arms moving fluidly, sometimes akimbo with hands on hips, sometimes outstretched pointing or waving above head
observation.hips_and_torso: frequent hip swiveling, twisting, and torso bends forward
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent turns, occasional low bends forward touching the floor, steps mostly at standing level
observation.costume_and_props: fringed dance dress or leotard, headband, low-heeled dance shoes
observation.cannot_infer: exact audio-to-step synchronization and rapid footwork details due to low frame rate and historic silent film format

signature_moments.what: twisting hips side to side with arms outstretched and hands pointing
swiveling knees inward and outward while keeping hands on hips
bending torso forward to touch the floor then springing up with arms raised
